Title: General availability: Azure SQL Managed Instance feature wave updates for November 2022

Body.Content:
The Azure SQL Managed Instance feature wave introduces a bundle of anticipated releases that work together to make SQL Managed Instance even more performant, reliable, and secure, while enabling even deeper integration with on-premises SQL Server and the broader Azure service platform. We are announcing the following generally available features in this first wave, which has begun rolling out. Your instances will be automatically updated as part of the regular service updates, at no cost and no additional downtime to you.  

  • Impose fewer mandatory rules on the degated subnet.
  • Virtual clusters hosting Azure SQL Managed Instance are enhanced with a new set of capabilities.

Learn more about the Azure SQL Managed Instance feature wave.
